title: Localization preserves a reduced tensor-product decomposition
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, B and C commutative R-algebras, and D_j (j in Fin r) commutative C-algebras. Suppose the reduction of B tensor_R C is C-algebra isomorphic to prod_j D_j. For x in C, let C' be any C-algebra realization of C[1/x], with compatible R-algebra structure. Then the reduction of B tensor_R C' is C'-algebra isomorphic to prod_j (C' tensor_C D_j). No domain, Noetherian, finiteness, etale or universal-homeomorphism hypotheses are assumed. The zero-factor product is included.

source.place: taking a common principal localization for the finitely many purely inseparable factors

proof.text: Put A = B tensor_R C and T = C' tensor_C A, using the right C-algebra structure on A. Tensor congruence with commRight, cancelBaseChange, and commRight identify T with B tensor_R C' as C'-algebras. Ideal.map_radical_of_surjective transports the nilradical across this algebra equivalence; quotientEquivAlg induces the equivalence of reductions.

Give T its right A-algebra structure. IsLocalization.tensorRight from Localization.BaseChange makes T the localization of A at the image of the powers of x. IsLocalization.map_radical applied to the zero ideal shows nilradical T is the extension of nilradical A. quotientEquivAlgOfEq and tensorQuotientEquiv therefore identify the reduction of T with C' tensor_C (A modulo nilradical A), as C'-algebras.

Tensor the supplied C-algebra splitting equivalence with the identity on C', using Algebra.TensorProduct.congr. Compose with Algebra.TensorProduct.piRight C C' C' D. This finite-product equivalence applies to every Fin r, including Fin 0, without an extra positivity assumption. Compose these four equivalences to obtain the claimed Nonempty C'-algebra equivalence.

theorem reduced_product_localization
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (B : Type v) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    (C : Type u) [CommRing C] [Algebra R C]
    (r : ℕ) (D : Fin r → Type u) [∀ j, CommRing (D j)] [∀ j, Algebra C (D j)]
    (hsplit : letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := B) (B := C)
      Nonempty (((B ⊗[R] C) ⧸ nilradical (B ⊗[R] C)) ≃ₐ[C] (∀ j, D j)))
    (x : C) (C' : Type u) [CommRing C'] [Algebra C C'] [IsLocalization.Away x C']
    [Algebra R C'] [IsScalarTower R C C'] :
    letI := Algebra.TensorProduct.rightAlgebra (R := R) (A := B) (B := C')
    Nonempty (((B ⊗[R] C') ⧸ nilradical (B ⊗[R] C')) ≃ₐ[C']
      (∀ j, C' ⊗[C] D j))
